paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart, titled "QLoRA," illustrates a comparison of GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) across different fine-tuning methods, with the y-axis representing GPU Memory (GB) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 20, and the x-axis displaying the methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours. The bars are arranged in a non-sequential order along the x-axis, with the category labels rotated for readability. The bar corresponding to Full FT is the tallest, reaching approximately 72 GB, followed by MTL-FT at around 40 GB. The bars for TAG and LoRA are of similar height, both approximately 22 GB. The QLoRA bar is visibly shorter, at about 14 GB, while the bar for Ours is the shortest, standing at approximately 22 GB. The bar for Ours is uniquely colored green, while all other bars are orange, indicating a visual distinction between the methods. The chart provides a visual representation of the memory consumption for each method, with the values on the y-axis allowing for a quantitative comparison of the GPU memory usage.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart, titled "QLoRA," compares GPU memory usage (in GB) across six different fine-tuning methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours. The vertical axis represents GPU Memory in gigabytes, scaled from 0 to 70 with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis lists the six methods. The bars for Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, and QLoRA are all orange, while the bar for "Ours" is green. The Full FT method requires the most memory, at approximately 70 GB. MTL-FT uses about 40 GB, TAG and LoRA use around 22 GB each, and QLoRA uses approximately 13 GB. The "Ours" method uses about 22 GB of GPU memory. The chart illustrates that the proposed method ("Ours") requires significantly less memory than Full FT and MTL-FT, while using more memory than LoRA and QLoRA.

Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert den GPU-Speicherbedarf in GB und ist linear skaliert mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 70, wobei die Beschriftungen in Schritten von 20 angegeben sind. Die Balken sind farblich kodiert: die ersten fünf Balken sind orange, während der letzte Balken, der „Ours“ entspricht, grün ist. Der Balken für „Full FT“ erreicht den höchsten Wert, der über 70 GB liegt, gefolgt von „MTL-FT“ mit etwa 40 GB. Die Balken für „TAG“, „LoRA“ und „QLoRA“ liegen bei etwa 22 GB, während der Balken für „Ours“ bei etwa 22 GB liegt, was auf einen vergleichbaren Speicherbedarf hinweist. Die Balken sind in alphabetischer Reihenfolge der Kategorien angeordnet, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder besondere Linien.
